title: prunus serotina var. montana
intro: Prunus serotina var. montana, commonly known as Mountain Black Cherry, is a deciduous shrub or small tree that belongs to the Rosaceae family. It is native to the eastern parts of North America, valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from colds, fever, and sore throats due to its health benefits. The plant is known for its therapeutic actions, such as being anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial, which aid in treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of Mountain Black Cherry include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and salicin, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
